name: SenseMaker® (The Cynefin Company)
description: Digital narrative-based research and sensemaking tool developed by The Cynefin Company (Dave Snowden). Used for capturing and analyzing distributed micro-narratives to detect emergent patterns in organizations and communities. The only tool designed explicitly around the Cynefin framework for detecting complex-domain dynamics through distributed narrative capture.
evaluation_method: distributed micro-narrative analysis, emergent pattern detection
notes: The only tool designed explicitly around the Cynefin framework. Used worldwide in organizational research, public policy, and community engagement.
